hero.subtitle: No hidden fees. No surprises. Just pick a plan and start uploading.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Still unsure? Here's what people usually ask before signing up.

upgrade-downgrade.question: Can I switch plans later?
upgrade-downgrade.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade at any time. Upgrades apply immediately, and downgrades take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.

storage-exceeded.question: What happens if I go over my storage limit?
storage-exceeded.answer: You'll get a notification once you're close to your limit. If you go over, you won't lose any files — you just won't be able to upload new ones until you free up space or upgrade your plan.

cancel-refund.question: Can I cancel anytime, and do you offer refunds?
cancel-refund.answer: You can cancel your subscription at any time with no extra fees. If you're on a paid plan and cancel within 14 days, you're eligible for a full refund.

data-security.question: How secure are my files?
data-security.answer: All files are encrypted both in transit and at rest. Only you (and anyone you explicitly share with) can access your data.

data-after-cancel.question: What happens to my files if I cancel?
data-after-cancel.answer: Your files stay accessible in read-only mode for 30 days after cancellation, giving you time to download everything. After that, your data is permanently deleted.

ripe-vs-harvest.question: What's the real difference between Ripe and Harvest?
ripe-vs-harvest.answer: Beyond more storage, Harvest is built for teams — it adds shared folders, team member roles, and priority support, while Ripe is designed for individual power users.
